final: WITH g AS (SELECT d.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp d JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id GROUP BY d.account_id, a.frequency), s AS (SELECT frequency, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g GROUP BY frequency), av AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM s) SELECT s.frequency, s.total, s.total - av.avg_total AS diff FROM s JOIN av ON av.avg_total IS NOT NULL WHERE s.total > av.avg_total
